title: Fossils And Archeology: Jurassic Park
description: This Resource pack aims to bring the Dinosaurs from the Jurassic Park (1993) to the Fossils & Archeology: Revival Genesis mod.
body:
"Welcome...to Jurassic Park"
==========================================================================
This Resource pack aims to bring the Dinosaurs from the Jurassic Park (1993), and other JP related midia, to the Fossils & Archeology: Revival Genesis mod.

If you use this texture in a youtube video, id appreciate for you to leave the link for it in the description :)

**The roaster:**

**Brachiosaurus**
- 1993(female) and 2001 (male) variants

**Raptors (Deinonychus)**
- 1993 and Kenner variants

**Dilophosaurus**
- 1993, JPTG, Kenner and Novel variants

**Gallimimus**
- 1993 and Kenner variants

**Parasaurolophus**
- 1993 and concept arts

**Triceratops**
- 1993 and concept arts

**Tyrannosaurus rex**
- 1993 (female), TLW (male), 2001(teen) variants
